messages:
Ryan (sales): OmniHealth POC starts Mon. They want 2-day smoke + throughput validation. Need reserved GPU preheat, autoscale policy, and answers to security Qs.
Alex (solutions): Request shape? tokens/out, burst vs steady, embeddings use?
Ryan (sales): Chat/generation. Bursts ~250 qps for short windows, steady ~60 qps. Avg output ~100 tokens.
Alex (solutions): Suggest reserved 6 GPUs, autoscale to 10-12 for sustained spikes. Quantized variants improve throughput but call out possible +2 GPU delta to meet same latency SLO.
Jen (infra): Autoscale suggestion: min_reserved=6, max_reserved=12, step=1 GPU per 30s, triggers: queued_requests + p95_latency. Also recommend burst credits for <3m spikes.
Sachin (sre): Agree on burst credits to avoid cold starts. OpsBot: schedule smoke test Mon 09:00 PT.
OpsBot: Scheduled smoke_test_omnichealth for 2026-04-06T16:00:00Z. Report to be posted here. :robot_face:
Priya (security): For questionnaire: we support VPC private deployment, KMS (customer-managed keys), SOC2 Type II, IP allowlist for console. Will draft formal responses by EOD.
Jen (infra): Preheat runbook snippet: seed top prompts, run 10qps warmer 10m, verify kv_cache_hit_rate >60%, add GPU if p95 exceeds target.
Alex (solutions): I'll produce 1-pager sizing rationale, pricing delta table (quant discount option), and a filled security checklist.
Ryan (sales): Please paste exact autoscale JSON for client ops.
Jen (infra): {"autoscale": {"min_reserved": 6, "max_reserved": 12, "scale_step_secs": 30, "burst_credit_threshold_secs": 180, "metrics": ["queued_requests", "p95_latency"]}}
Sachin (sre): I'll attach eviction/spot fallback tolerance table and SLA notes.
Ryan (sales): Thanks team. Priya ping me when security doc is ready and I'll loop legal. :thumbsup:
